title: Sitting-drop vapour-diffusion setup on a mosquito nanolitre dispenser
summary: Fill a 96-well sitting-drop plate with reservoir, dispense equal 200 nL volumes of protein and reservoir into each drop at room temperature, and seal the plate. Example from a methods section of a crystallography paper; the crystallisation recipe itself is protein specific.

steps.text: Fill the reservoirs of a 96-well MRC (SwissCI) sitting-drop plate with about 80 uL of screen solution each.
Load protein and plate onto the mosquito nanolitre liquid handler held at about 20 C (293 K).
Dispense 200 nL protein and 200 nL reservoir solution into each drop well.

duration_s.note: Per-plate dispense time not stated; 96 drops at about 6 s assumed.

steps.text: Seal the plate with clear sealing tape.
Move the plate to an incubator or imager at constant temperature (20 C here; another paper in this set used 4 C or 20 C).

safety: Screens may contain toxic salts or organics; wear gloves.

source.publisher: Journal of Applied Crystallography (IUCr, via PMC)

notes: Source licence line quotes CC-BY. Instrument model (mosquito Xtal3 vs LCP) is not stated; catalog id is the pipeline default. The 200+200 nL ratio was used for one protein and is not universal.
